subject: an Italian scholar of the early 1600s with reddish-brown hair, a broad forehead and a short full beard, alert searching eyes, wearing a plain dark wool scholar's gown with a small white linen collar

panels.01-lamp: a seventeen-year-old Italian student in a dark 1580s doublet and short cape standing in the vast marble nave of Pisa cathedral, looking up at a bronze hanging lamp swinging on a long chain, two fingers pressed to his own wrist to feel his pulse, shafts of light through high windows, 1581
panels.02-padua: {S} as a younger man lecturing on geometry in a wood-panelled hall of the University of Padua in 1592, drawing a circle and triangle on a slate board, students in 1590s doublets and gowns on wooden benches listening intently
panels.03-senate: {S} on a high stone balcony in Venice in August 1609, handing a long leather-covered spyglass tube to an elderly Venetian senator in red robes who looks through it toward ships far out in the lagoon, other senators in robes waiting their turn, domes and rooftops below, bright summer light
panels.04-moon: {S} at night on a small balcony in Padua in 1609, eye to a long thin wooden telescope tube resting on a stand, a half Moon bright in the sky, on a table beside him paper sheets with ink-wash drawings of the Moon's craters and shadows, a candle shielded by his hand
panels.05-jupiter: {S} seated at a wooden table by an open window on a cold January night in 1610, a long telescope on a stand pointed at a bright planet with tiny points of light in a line beside it, writing in a notebook rows of small sketches of a circle with dots on either side, one for each night, quiet concentration, starry sky
panels.06-sunspots: {S} and a younger assistant in a darkened room in Florence in 1612, sunlight entering only through a telescope fixed in the shutter and projecting a bright round image of the Sun onto a sheet of white paper on an easel, small dark spots visible on the bright disc, the older man tracing the spots with a pen, neither man looking at the Sun
panels.07-trial: an older {S} with a grey beard, kneeling upright and dignified in a plain penitent's robe in a vaulted stone hall in Rome in June 1633, reading from a paper, a long table of seated cardinals in red robes before him, solemn quiet atmosphere, no violence
panels.08-arcetri: an elderly blind {S} with white beard seated in a chair in the sunny loggia of a modest Tuscan villa at Arcetri in 1638, dictating to a young student who writes at a desk, a long wooden ramp with a groove and a bronze ball and a water vessel on the table beside them, olive trees and hills beyond
